item.text:
No additional finding category was added in this pass, but capacity validation coverage is now complete:

- Zero command, outgoing, incoming, or event capacity panics during `spawn_actor`.
- Zero `decided_channel_capacity` allows actor startup but panics later in `subscribe_decided` when the bounded channel is constructed.

The audit remains at 28 confirmed findings. Highest-impact issues remain LFU replica divergence, delta-snapshot corruption, decided-index regression during synchronization, persistent failed-write leakage/data deletion, timeout retry duplication, and LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The updated report and retained logs are available at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
